verdict.rationale: While Canva exposes Connect APIs, OAuth-based integrations, and an MCP server for AI assistants, none of the evidence describes issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials specifically for an agent (e.g., granular OAuth scopes, per-agent API keys, or restricted permission sets). Private integrations are gated by plan tier (docs-41) rather than granular scoping, and MCP/AI Connector docs discuss connecting an assistant but not credential scoping controls. Missing for 10: explicit scope/permission model for API keys or OAuth tokens issued to agents, documentation of least-privilege credential issuance, and any audit/control mechanism tied to agent-specific access.
